files.README.md:
# Dunthorpe Removals - charges

Household moves are quoted from the charges sheet under `fees/`. The sheet lists the firm's standard charges, and the office quotes any work the sheet does not list once the move has been surveyed.

files.docs/office-notes.md:
# Office notes

Estimates are sent by email and are held for thirty days.
Deposits are taken on moves booked more than a month ahead.
